title: Why Space Isn't Totally Silent During the 2024 Eclipse

scenes.text: During the 2024 total solar eclipse over Spain, did you hear any sound?
Most people think outer space is completely silent because there’s no air.
scenes.label: Space is completely silent

scenes.text: In a vacuum sound waves can’t travel, but vibrations travel through solid objects and astronauts hear sounds via radios and spacecraft structures.
scenes.label: Sound travels through solids

scenes.text: You can actually hear the ISS humming through its metal hull.
scenes.label: ISS HUMMING
scenes.sub: Vibrations move through metal, not air

scenes.text: Follow to feed your curious mind daily.

description: Many believe space is absolutely quiet, but vibrations let us hear the ISS and other sounds through metal structures. Follow for daily science!
